description: Figure 4 is a single stacked bar chart (no sub-panels) comparing the number percentage of inclusion types in three Fe-15Mn-Al-C samples labelled 1#, 2# and 3# on the categorical x-axis. The y-axis is labelled "Number percentage (%)" and runs 0-100 with ticks/gridlines every 10; no data labels are printed, so segment lengths must be read against the gridlines. A top-right legend lists eight hatched categories in the order Al2O3-AlN-MnS (horizontal lines), TiN-MnS (cross-hatch), AlN-MnS (vertical lines), Al2O3-MnS (diagonal lines), TiN (fine grid), MnS (diagonal lines), AlN (coarse grid), Al2O3 (diagonal lines); this order matches the stacking of the bars from top down, so each bar is read bottom-up as Al2O3, AlN, MnS, TiN, Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS, Al2O3-AlN-MnS. Approximate reading: the Al2O3 segment shrinks from about a third of the bar in 1# to a thin sliver in 3#; the coarse-grid AlN segment grows from roughly a tenth of bar 1# to about 60 % of bar 3#; MnS is widest in 2# (about a third) and narrower in 1# and 3#; the four complex-inclusion segments occupy roughly the upper quarter to third. The upper part of bars 2# and 3#, but not 1#, carries a light blue shading that has no legend entry.

observations.observation: Figure 4 is a single stacked bar chart with three bars labelled 1#, 2# and 3# on the x-axis; the y-axis is labelled "Number percentage (%)" spanning 0 to 100 with gridline ticks every 10.

The legend contains eight hatched inclusion categories, listed top-to-bottom as Al2O3-AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS, AlN-MnS, Al2O3-MnS, TiN, MnS, AlN and Al2O3; this order corresponds to the stacking order of the bar segments from top to bottom, so Al2O3 is the bottom-most segment.
The bottom Al2O3 segment of bar 1# extends to roughly the 30-40 % gridlines, whereas the corresponding segment in bar 3# is only a few percent thick and the one in bar 2# lies between them.

The coarse-grid texture assigned to AlN occupies roughly the 30-45 % band in bar 1#, the 10-35 % band in bar 2#, and the 0-60 % band in bar 3#, i.e. the AlN fraction grows strongly with sample number.
The MnS segment is widest in bar 2# (roughly the 35-65 % band) and narrower in bar 1# and bar 3#, so the MnS number percentage is non-monotonic across the three samples.
The upper part of bars 2# and 3# (above roughly 65-70 % in 2# and above roughly 75 % in 3#) is filled with a light blue shading, while bar 1# has no such shading and no legend entry explains it.
No numeric values are printed on the bars; all segment proportions can only be estimated against the 10 %-interval gridlines.
The caption states that Figure 4 gives the number percentage of inclusions in three samples.
The citing text states that the number percentage of single Al2O3 inclusions in the steel decreases as Al content increases.
The citing text states that the number percentage of single AlN inclusions gradually increases as Al content increases.
The citing text states that the number percentage of single MnS inclusions first increases and then decreases as Al content increases.
The citing text states that the number percentage of single TiN inclusions does not change significantly with increasing Al content.
The citing text states that Al2O3-MnS inclusions increase with Al content while AlN-MnS and TiN-MnS inclusions show a decreasing trend.

The citing text states that Al2O3-AlN-MnS inclusions exist in the 1# and 2# samples but were not observed in the 3# sample, consistent with the legend entry for Al2O3-AlN-MnS being a minor top band in the two lower-Al bars.
The samples compared are the 1# to 3# samples of Fe-15Mn-Al-C low-density steel with different Al contents (Al = 1, 3, 5 per the abstract).
